title: Scientists discover a surprising clue to why some brains resist Alzheimer’s
caption:
Scientists discovered that rare immature neurons persist in the elderly and act differently in people who stay mentally sharp despite Alzheimer’s pathology. Their protective activity could be a key to cognitive resilience, opening new research directions.

Source: Sciencedaily - Scientists discover a surprising clue to why some brains resist Alzheimer’s

https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/10/261025222538.htm
